manifest.description: Diagnose Java framework API use that violates caller role or lifecycle contracts static tools cannot fully infer.
when_to_use: Spring, Guice, Vaadin, JOOQ, servlet, validation, or async lifecycle use looks valid syntactically but wrong for the caller role
the same API call is legitimate in bootstrap or adapter code but suspect in domain or service code
a correction plan needs the framework contract, failure mode, and idiomatic replacement
anti_patterns: do not use for framework violations a static checker already proves
do not use for ordinary API misuse unrelated to architecture or lifecycle
do not use on non-Java targets
